homepage.section_1_doors: 3 Editorial Doors (LEND / RENT / BUY). Rent tile features crossfade carousel: 1.4s fade animation, 5.2s hold. Converts to swipeable horizontal row below 860px breakpoint.
homepage.section_2_curated_grid: Product listing grid (4 columns desktop, 2 columns mobile). 2:3 aspect ratio photo container with bg #EFEEEC. Shows verified auth badge, brand, item name, strikethrough retail, $/day rent rate, buy price if available, lender name/rating, Boston MA location.
homepage.section_3_brand_strip: THE BRANDS strip featuring 7 portrait tiles (Chanel, Gucci, Dior, Hermès, Burberry, LV, Prada) with left/right navigation arrows.
homepage.section_4_authenticity: BUILT ON AUTHENTICITY 3-step value proposition (50-point physical authentication, $10,000 lender guarantee, white-glove climate delivery).
homepage.section_5_how_it_works: Interactive How It Works module for Renters and Lenders.
homepage.section_6_newsletter: Minimalist newsletter subscription with underline input and 52px JOIN CTA.
homepage.section_7_footer: Editorial footer with dark section background #1F1A17 and light text #F3F1ED.

catalogue.controls: Grid layout switcher (4 cols, 3 cols, 2 cols), FILTERS drawer toggle button, Rent/Buy toggle switch, Sort dropdown, Brand shortcut pills.
catalogue.filter_drawer: Slide-out panel: Brand multi-select, Color swatch filter, Availability date range, Authenticity tier filter, Price slider.

product_detail.gallery: Primary image preview with prev/next arrows + side thumbnail strip showcasing handbag condition, corners, serial stamp, and lining.
product_detail.booking_card: Sticky sidebar panel on white #FFFFFF. Select rental dates, duration counter, daily rate calculation, $35 insurance fee, refundable security deposit, total price, and 52px REQUEST TO RENT button.
product_detail.purchase_card: Optional Buy Now option if listing supports outright sale.
product_detail.authenticity_card: Verified 50-Point Authenticity Certificate badge with hologram seal representation.

additional_pages.renter_dashboard: Active Rentals, Upcoming Booking Calendar, Saved Handbags, Rental History, Security Deposit Status.
additional_pages.lender_dashboard: My Wardrobe Listings, Earnings Overview ($ value), Rental Requests (Approve/Decline), Payout Account Settings.
additional_pages.listing_creation: 4-Step Listing Flow: Basic Info & Brand, Photo Upload (2:3 aspect ratio), Authentication Proof & Serial No., Pricing ($/day & Buy Outright option).
additional_pages.auth_modal: Login / Sign Up modal with underline form inputs and tab switcher.
additional_pages.support_contact: Concierge FAQ accordions + Underline Contact Form.
additional_pages.style_guide: Interactive UI Spec page showing Typography (Prata & Jost), Color Tokens, 52px Button States, Underline Form Fields, Badges, and Grid Systems.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, links, inputs, tiles, tabs, and filters MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='rent-door-cta', data-testid='filter-drawer-toggle', data-testid='request-to-rent-button').
testing_and_accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query. Minimal, weighted transitions only (1.4s crossfade, subtle hover lift).
